skill_path: Start by earning a pharmacy technician certificate to build foundational knowledge in medications and pharmacy guidelines, which directly supports your healthcare career goals. Simultaneously, practice data-entry and Microsoft Excel through online tutorials or free courses, as these skills are crucial for administrative roles in clinics or hospitals. Look for entry-level positions like medical receptionist or pharmacy assistant to gain hands-on experience with customer service and confidentiality, gradually transitioning into a medical assistant or nursing role.
